name: Usable cargo capacity forecast
dataSource: Synthetic history generated from documented assumptions
method: Gradient boosted quantile regression (scikit learn), with linear quantile regression as reference
limits: Trained on simulated data. It shows the method. Real accuracy needs the airline's own flight history.

explanation.forecast: SHAP TreeExplainer (interventional). Each driver is its contribution to the median forecast, in kg.
explanation.decisions: Regulatory screen per shipment and leg, underbooking and overbooking cost, critical ratio, learned time sensitivity risk, the rule that blocks each alternative, and counterfactual re solves.

timeSensitivity.name: Shipment time sensitivity
timeSensitivity.architecture: Two discrete-time neural hazard models, each with 48, 24 and 12 ReLU units
timeSensitivity.limits: Held-out Brier scores use complete simulator outcomes. Training uses censored histories. Hold out real disruptions for calibration.

regulatoryEligibility.inputs: Verified declaration attributes and simulated per-package leg acceptance
